exploration_assessment.new_validation_method: Camera-render inspection of branch candidates; no new geometric diagnostic.
exploration_assessment.explanation: Two door approaches are evidenced: fixed-location swing adjustments and a translated/reversed hinge assembly, followed by return to the original hinge with widened, face-reversed panels. Camera remained fixed in the source. Multiple distinct renders were read and later edits made, but there is no explicit comparison or selection judgment; therefore a fixed-camera comparison is not credited. Repeated 53-degree execution is not a distinct path.

failure_or_stopping_observations: Seven Blender executions report scene and image saves; logs show a use_nodes deprecation warning, not a traceback (evidence/executions/*/stdout.log and stderr.log).
The 53-degree candidate was rerun without a code change, with identical image byte counts (sdk_events.json events 8-15; index.json image associations).

The final report asserts a visible paneled face (sdk_events.json event 52); no explicit collision test, top/side view, visibility diagnostic, or quantitative reference comparison appears in the student trace.
The independently generated target_geometry.json gives final geometry, not a student measurement.

candidate_knowledge.problem: Door leaf insufficiently visible from the reconstruction camera.
candidate_knowledge.observed_defect: The received hint describes the broad angled reference door versus the mainly dark reconstructed opening.
candidate_knowledge.cause_hypothesis: Back-wall hiding or near-edge-on projection; teacher diagnosis presents these as competing hypotheses.
candidate_knowledge.executed_method: Change parent hinge swing, try translated hinge and reversed leaf, then restore hinge and widen leaf with panel details on the opposite side.
candidate_knowledge.applicability: Potentially useful when tuning a parented door in a single camera view; cross-scene transfer is untested.
candidate_knowledge.verification: Student read successive renders and reported final visible panel; no explicit comparative judgment or geometry check.
candidate_knowledge.side_effects: Final leaf width 1.70 versus dark opening width .78; possible collisions and changed proportions were not checked.
candidate_knowledge.unvalidated: Root cause, physical attachment, clearance, and true reference dimensions.

limitations: Reference geometry is hidden; image appearance cannot establish true 3D placement.
Scene states and target_geometry.json are independent evaluator outputs and are not student checks.
No full-reference image-plane shortcut is evidenced by the executed source; the scene is assembled from mesh primitives.
Render reads alone do not prove an explicit comparison, preference, or controlled visibility test.
